title: Cosmic Awareness
definition: The understanding that the universe and consciousness are interconnected and that we are a part of a greater whole.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of consciousness as a wave that flows through the universe. Cosmic awareness is understanding this flow and being connected to it.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Cosmic awareness is a philosophical concept that draws from quantum physics, Buddhism, and self-awareness. It suggests that the universe and consciousness are deeply interconnected, and that we can learn from this interconnectedness.
difficulty_levels.expert: Cosmic awareness is a novel insight that explores the philosophical implications of the quantum reality as perception. It suggests that the universe is a vast, interconnected system of consciousness, and that our self-awareness and understanding of the universe are intimately related. Cosmic awareness also raises questions about the nature of reality and consciousness, and its connections to other fields such as evolutionary biology and systems theory.

extra_fields.insight: The universe and consciousness are deeply interconnected, and our self-awareness and understanding of the universe are intimately related.
